title: 持續整合與交付管線
summary: 以隔離建置、證據與受控部署連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
summaryEn: Sixteen technical units connect isolated builds, evidence and controlled deployment through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.

stages.title: 原始碼與觸發
stages.description: 四個技術單元以原理／架構與實驗／驗證兩步完成「原始碼與觸發」；每步獨立保存進度與知識測驗。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop sources and triggers through separate principle/architecture and experiment/validation tasks with saved progress and knowledge checks.

steps.title: 觸發邊界：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「觸發邊界」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for trigger boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「觸發邊界」的資料、控制與時間關係。外部 PR 代碼與發佈信任等級不同。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「分類事件可取用的權限。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for trigger boundaries. External PR code and releases have different trust levels. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Classify permissions available to events. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 分類事件可取用的權限。
steps.failure: 常見誤判：秘密遮蔽會可靠移除所有編碼變形。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Secret masking reliably removes every encoded transformation. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「觸發邊界」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「外部 PR 代碼與發佈信任等級不同。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit trigger boundaries two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.title: 觸發邊界的原理與邊界
knowledge.text: 外部 PR 代碼與發佈信任等級不同。
knowledge.textEn: External PR code and releases have different trust levels.

knowledge.title: 觸發邊界的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 分類事件可取用的權限。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Classify permissions available to events. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設串列工作 2、8、6、4 min，總 20 min；若 8 與 6 min 可獨立平行，關鍵路徑=2+max(8,6)+4=14 min。兩工作不得共享可變 workspace；runner 成本仍約 20 worker-min。
knowledge.textEn: Assume serial jobs of 2, 8, 6 and 4 min: 20 min. Independent parallel 8/6 min jobs give a 14 min critical path. They must not share mutable workspaces; total worker time remains about 20 worker-min.

steps.title: 觸發邊界：實驗與驗證
steps.objective: 用「分類事件可取用的權限。」檢查「觸發邊界」的假設、結果及失效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for trigger boundaries using the specified experiment.

steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for trigger boundaries and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Classify permissions available to events. Check the principle: External PR code and releases have different trust levels. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 分類事件可取用的權限。
steps.failure: 常見誤判：秘密遮蔽會可靠移除所有編碼變形。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Secret masking reliably removes every encoded transformation. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「觸發邊界」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「分類事件可取用的權限。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit trigger boundaries input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for clean environments.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「乾淨環境」的資料、控制與時間關係。上一次工作殘留可影響下一次產物。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較乾淨與汙染假想環境。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for clean environments. Prior-job residue can affect artifacts. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare clean and contaminated environments. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 比較乾淨與汙染假想環境。
steps.failure: 常見誤判：快取命中就可略過依賴與來源驗證。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Cache hits permit skipping dependency/source verification. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「乾淨環境」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「上一次工作殘留可影響下一次產物。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit clean environments two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.title: 乾淨環境的原理與邊界
knowledge.text: 上一次工作殘留可影響下一次產物。
knowledge.textEn: Prior-job residue can affect artifacts.

knowledge.title: 乾淨環境的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 比較乾淨與汙染假想環境。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Compare clean and contaminated environments. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

quiz.question: 本步審查「乾淨環境」與整體「持續整合與交付管線」時，哪項陳述或驗證有依據？

options: 上一次工作殘留可影響下一次產物。

Check the principle: Prior-job residue can affect artifacts. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 比較乾淨與汙染假想環境。
steps.failure: 常見誤判：快取命中就可略過依賴與來源驗證。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。

knowledge.textEn: Draw read-only/release rights matrices. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

quiz.question: 本步審查「最小權限」與整體「持續整合與交付管線」時，哪項陳述或驗證有依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing least privilege within continuous integration and delivery pipelines, which statement or check is supported?
options: 建置與部署不必具有相同權限。
秘密遮蔽會可靠移除所有編碼變形。
快取命中就可略過依賴與來源驗證。
optionsEn: Build and deployment need different privileges.
Secret masking reliably removes every encoded transformation.
Cache hits permit skipping dependency/source verification.
quiz.explanation: 建置與部署不必具有相同權限。 畫只讀與發布權限矩陣。 其餘選項混淆不同架構或證據的適用邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Build and deployment need different privileges. Draw read-only/release rights matrices. The alternatives confuse architectural or evidence boundaries.

steps.title: 最小權限：實驗與驗證
steps.objective: 用「畫只讀與發布權限矩陣。」檢查「最小權限」的假設、結果及失效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for least privilege using the specified experiment.
steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「最小權限」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：畫只讀與發布權限矩陣。 核對「建置與部署不必具有相同權限。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for least privilege and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Draw read-only/release rights matrices. Check the principle: Build and deployment need different privileges. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 畫只讀與發布權限矩陣。
steps.failure: 常見誤判：快取命中就可略過依賴與來源驗證。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Cache hits permit skipping dependency/source verification. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「最小權限」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「畫只讀與發布權限矩陣。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit least privilege input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Audit fictional base64/split outputs. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

knowledge.text: 假設串列工作 2、8、6、4 min，總 20 min；若 8 與 6 min 可獨立平行，關鍵路徑=2+max(8,6)+4=14 min。兩工作不得共享可變 workspace；runner 成本仍約 20 worker-min。
